requirement: Candidate commit, exact base commit, app-tree and output-manifest identities
scope: All 127 manifest entries match current bytes; candidate is bound to the pinned base and expected app tree.

requirement: Valid UTF-8 patch applies to exact base and maps every replacement byte-for-byte
scope: Fresh detached replay; 25 paths; exact app tree; 25/25 replacement equality.

requirement: Exhaustive A1 path ownership; frozen content contract and dependency files remain unchanged
scope: All 25 candidate paths are within the A1 table; canonical app tree remains the pinned base tree.

requirement: Complete maker requirement matrix included in the candidate package
scope: R4 has a narrative report table but no standalone requirement-matrix.json; this file is an independent audit matrix.

requirement: Historical source/patch/receipt writer attribution
scope: Current bytes are identified; live process snapshots cannot establish an exited writer. No external Gemini execution is claimed.

requirement: ReviewIdentity and PrivateDraftReview schemas strictly validate complete DTOs
scope: The schema accepts duplicate project IDs, arbitrary timestamp text, unknown draft object shapes, and canPublish=true with an empty checks list.

requirement: API and durable service require the complete review and matching expected revision before writes
scope: PGlite integration verifies missing/mismatched review rejection and unchanged publication/history/audit state; not hosted PostgreSQL.

requirement: Durable publication revision and project locks are read in one ordered transaction
scope: Embedded PGlite verifies durable revision 7 and ordered transaction lock trace; no native multi-process race claim.

requirement: Canonical candidate hash binds project bodies and ordered document content
scope: Hash input contains only project ID/revision pairs; changed body and reversed sections with the same revision hash identically.

requirement: ReviewedMedia binds available row identity and latest approval-audit event
scope: Source binds object key, hash, MIME, bytes, dimensions, provenance, status, timestamps and audit ID; integration reproduces four valid same-ID changes in embedded SQL and mocked Storage.

requirement: Safe integer and lowercase SHA-256 identity validation
scope: Lowercase SHA-256 has a strict regex; the audit probe confirms Zod integer validation rejects an unsafe byte count.

requirement: Actual private image bytes are checked against type, maximum size, hash, dimensions and row values
scope: PGlite/mocked Storage covers a valid synthetic PNG and tampered bytes; no provider-backed Storage claim.

requirement: Private Storage accumulation is bounded and reads have a deadline/abort
scope: The full Blob arrayBuffer is read before the 5 MiB validator; the probe observes 5 MiB + 1 byte materialized before rejection.

requirement: Valid same-ID media/approval mutations invalidate the old review with no partial writes
scope: Object-key, provenance, creation-time and approval-audit changes are exercised with synthetic valid PNG data and embedded SQL; this is not a native database race.

requirement: Full media vector/order/dedup and concurrent native-provider mutation matrix
scope: Code sorts/deduplicates referenced IDs and covered same-ID cases pass; complete metadata variant matrix, native PostgreSQL/Auth/Storage and multi-process races were not run.

requirement: Approved-media route, image-save validation and private proxy byte rejection
scope: Local PGlite/synthetic auth/mocked Storage verifies media-list shape, missing-image save rejection and tampered proxy rejection.

requirement: Browser selection and preview of an approved image
scope: Chromium asserts only the empty picker; no approved media object is selected or previewed. The candidate records this limitation.

requirement: Four block editors, ordering/focus, failed-buffer retention, save/reopen and cancel
scope: 10 Chromium tests pass with local fixture; image block is created in empty state then removed after expected 422, so image selection/edit is not covered.

requirement: Private draft rendering, CandidateX privacy, and safe draft-only media route boundaries
scope: PGlite/server rendering and local Chromium verify CandidateX draft visibility and public exclusion; approved-image rendering was not browser-tested.

requirement: Rollback concurrency/reason and truthful committed/origin/edge visibility states
scope: Local integration/browser workflow exercises rollback; CDN/edge visibility is explicitly unobserved.

requirement: Private cache headers on authenticated, denial, validation and not-found branches
scope: Selected 401/403/404/422 and success branches pass synthetic/local checks; provider outage/503 matrix was not run.

requirement: Public HTML/API/build output do not expose pre-publication private sentinels or media
scope: Chromium public portfolio check passes and the built .next output has no named private sentinel matches; no CDN/shared-edge cache proof.

requirement: Offline install, full unit/integration suites, lint, typecheck and production build
scope: Exact isolated candidate: install pass; 24/314 unit; 28/313 integration; lint/typecheck/build exit 0.

requirement: Chromium authoring/publication workflows on the bound candidate server
scope: 10/10 pass with YOR_E2E_FIXTURE=1 and a local test database. A preceding no-fixture run failed 6/10 at the owner login redirect; no native Auth/Storage is established.

requirement: Native providers, live deployment/CDN, physical device, PDF, recovery and G7 acceptance
scope: No external services, credentials, provider sessions, physical devices or recovery process were accessed.

requirement: Exact R3 preservation and attributable R4 package lineage
scope: R3 baseline and later inventories differ; R4 source/patch/receipt writer remains unknown. No attribution or intent inferred.
